title: Custom _app.js is being ignored when using React Server Components

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information Operating System: Platform: linux Arch: x64 Version: #123-Ubuntu SMP Fri Apr 8 09:10:54 UTC 2022 Binaries: Node: 16.14.0 npm: 8.3.1 Yarn: 1.22.5 pnpm: 7.0.0 Relevant packages: next: 12.1.7-canary.0 react: 18.1.0 react-dom: 18.1.0 ### What browser are you using? (if relevant) Chrome, Firefox ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) next start ### Describe the Bug Custom app on _app.tsx is ignored, when using React Server Components (with fresh create-next-app installation) ### Expected Behavior Elements returned from custom app function on _app.tsx should be rendered on screen. ### To Reproduce Github repo to reproduce: https://github.com/chenraz/nextjs-rsc.git 1. Create next app: `pnpm create next-app@latest -- --ts` 2. Enable experimental RSC on next.config.js: ``` /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ const nextConfig = { reactStrictMode: true, experimental: { runtime: 'nodejs', serverComponents: true, }, } module.exports = nextConfig ``` 3. Add layout to _app.tsx: ``` import '../styles/globals.css' import type { AppProps } from 'next/app' function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) { return
ADD SOMETHING BEFORE
} export default MyApp ``` **So far so good - custom app layout is rendered on screen.** 4. Modify `pages/index.tsx` to `pages/index.server.tsx` **Custom app layout does not render on screen.**
